instruction.text: Giuliano went to a clothing store where there was a 20% discount on all t-shirts. If the original price of a t-shirt was £50, how much will he pay after the discount?
instruction.sound: Giuliano went to a clothing store where there was a 20% discount on all tshirts. If the original price of a tshirt was £50, how much will he pay after the discount?

atoms.a: Subtract the discount from the full price of the t-shirt.
Divide the percentage by 100 to get a decimal.
Multiply the decimal by the original price.

atoms.b: Giuliano will have to pay <mat>£<gap>40</gap></mat> to buy a t-shirt.

instruction.text: Jaqueline has a monthly mobile data allowance of 5 gigabytes. By the middle of the month, she has already used up 60% of her allowance. How many gigabytes has she used?

atoms.a: Divide the percentage by 100 to get a decimal.
Multiply the decimal by the total data allowance.

atoms.b: Jaqueline has already used <mat><gap>3</gap></mat> gigabytes this month.

instruction.text: Lucas wants to buy a new video game that costs £40. He saves 25% of his £10 weekly allowance each week to buy the game. How much money does he save each week?

atoms.a: Divide the percentage by 100 to get a decimal.
Multiply the decimal by his weekly allowance.
How many weeks will it take him to save enough for the game?

atoms.b: Lucas will have to save up for <mat><gap>16</gap></mat> weeks to buy this game.

instruction.text: In a class of 30 students, 70% of the students have handed in their homework on time. How many students handed in their homework on time?

atoms.a: Divide the percentage by 100 to get a decimal.
Multiply the decimal by the amount of students in the class.

atoms.b: <mat><gap>21</gap></mat> students handed in their homework on time.

instruction.text: A school has a goal to recycle 80% of its paper waste. If the school used 500 kilograms of paper last year, how many kilograms do they aim to recycle?

atoms.a: Divide the percentage by 100 to get a decimal.
Multiply the decimal by the weight of used paper.

atoms.b: The school aims to recycle <mat><gap>400</gap></mat> kilograms of paper.
